hints.content:
The key understanding here is that there isn't a single way to define "athletic achievement." Number of sports medals won can be a good measure of that. Percentage of students in sports club is also a good measure.

Now let's go over the options and see which of them might be used to describe "athletic achievements relative to the SAT average."

Definition | Analysis | Appropriate?
:- | :- | :-:
% of students in sports club divided by SAT average | "% of students in sports club" is a measure of athletic achievement. Dividing this by the SAT average gives us a good definition. | $\greenD{\text{Yes}}$
Graduation rate divided by SAT average | "Graduation rate" isn't a measure of athletic achievement. | $\redD{\text{No}}$
Number of sports medals won |  "Number of sports medals won" is a measure of athletic achievement, but this isn't divided by the SAT average. | $\redD{\text{No}}$
Number of sports medals won divided by SAT average | "Number of sports medals won" is a measure of athletic achievement. Dividing this by the SAT average gives us a good definition. | $\greenD{\text{Yes}}$

We are left with two definitions for athletic achievements relative to the SAT average:

1. % of students in sports club divided by SAT average
2. Number of sports medals won divided by SAT average

Let's calculate the athletic achievements relative to the SAT average for each school according to each definition:

School | Definition #1 | Definition #2
:-: | :-: | :-:
A | $\approx 0.052\,\dfrac{\text{percents}}{\text{point}}$ | $0.0075\,\dfrac{\text{medals}}{\text{point}}$
B | $\approx 0.065\,\dfrac{\text{percents}}{\text{point}}$ | $\approx 0.0067\,\dfrac{\text{medals}}{\text{point}}$
Which school has higher athletic achievements relative to the SAT average? | School B | School A

question.content:
Analia is a school district manager. Here are some details about two schools in her district for the last school year:

 | School A | School B
:- | :-: | :-:
Number of students | $3000$ | $4000$
Number of teachers | $190$ | $380$
Graduation rate | $86\%$ | $90\%$
Budget per student | $\$10{,}500$ | $\$10{,}000$
% of students in sports club | $62\%$ | $68\%$
Number of sports medals won | $9$ | $7$
SAT average | $1200$ | $1050$
SAT range (max-min) | $900$ | $700$

Analia wants to know which school has higher athletic achievements relative to the SAT average.

**1) Analia thought of two different ways to define this quantity. Identify these two definitions among the following options.**

[[☃ radio 1]]

**2) Determine which school has higher athletic achievements relative to the SAT average, according to the two definitions. Did you get the same result for both definitions? **

[[☃ radio 3]]

Graduation rate divided by SAT average
